source.note: U.S. note 51 to subchapter III of chapter 99, HTSUS

note: Section 338 coverage is enacted as U.S. note 51 to subchapter III of chapter 99. Codes are 8-digit HTSUS lines; entries file at 10 digits. Screening is at 8 digits: a covered 8-digit heading is treated as catching every 10-digit statistical suffix beneath it. This is a deliberate decision, taken 5 September 2026, and it is the conservative direction — it can flag a line that a 10-digit reading might exclude, but it will not miss a covered one. Section 232 and forced-labour measures are scope-level records, not code lists.
